issue.title: just test-slow deterministically fails via temp-leak guard due to uv_tool harness lock files
issue.description: tests/uv_tool/test_real_uv_harness.py leaves two uv-setuptools-*.lock files behind in the pytest scratch TMPDIR root on every run. tests/_tmp_leak_guard.py's session-finish check (finish_tmp_leak_guard) treats any unrecognized new entry under the watched temp root as a leak and flips the pytest exit status to TESTS_FAILED, so 'just test-slow' exits 1 every time even though all of its tests pass. Reproduced twice in a row at commit 4330fd0d5 plus the test_suite_tier0 plan's changes: '10 passed, 2 skipped' followed immediately by 'recipe test-slow failed on line 338 with exit code 1', with the leak report naming 'uv-setuptools-<hash>.lock' both times. This matters now because sase/repos/plans/202608/test_suite_tier0.md just added a 'Run slow tests' / 'just test-slow' step to the CI perf-floors job (with if: always()), so this failure will now surface on every CI run once that plan lands. Fix options: make tests/uv_tool/test_real_uv_harness.py route uv's lock file through an explicit scratch dir so it lands under a location the guard already ignores or under tmp_path, or add 'uv-setuptools-*.lock' to tests/_tmp_leak_guard.py's FOREIGN_ENTRY_PATTERNS if this is legitimate third-party (uv) scratch rather than a real leak from sase's own code.
